name: no_lane_region_plunger
description: Ball at (293,222) v=(60,0), plunger held 30 frames: inside the region that is the plunger lane in EP1 (x>=280, y>=220). EP8 has no lane: vx is never zeroed, and the plunger only sets the launch flag ds:5AEC while no ball is active (cs:0B62..0B7C skip the launch block while any of slots 0..2 is active).
